span.term: SHARING MEASURED AT A STATED DEPTH: almost 40% of each individual's genes are shared with at least half the cohort, and the sentence carries its own qualifier - AT THE PRESENT DEPTH OF SEQUENCING

span.label: The cohort is 124 European adults, Nordic and Mediterranean, and the paper states that scope in its own summary sentence
span.note: about this quote: the quote carries an extractor fusion: the paper's “non-redundant” is staged as “nonredundant”. Verbatim against the staged text; the damage is mid-word and no re-slice avoids it. Confidence 0.85 under Q-606.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The proportion of shared genes is stated to be BOUNDED BY FUTURE WORK rather than settled here, which makes the sharing figure provisional by the authors' own account
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The sharing result is explicitly conditioned on the sequencing depth used

span.label: one of the two samples was ALSO sequenced on a different platform (Roche/454) and the assemblies compared - 97.9 per cent collinear over 99.5 per cent of mapped regions
span.note: eliminates: that the assembly is an artefact of the Illumina platform or of the assembler, rather than the biology - a second technology with different error modes should not reproduce a shared artefact
